title: Felsite
summary: FEL'SITE, noun [See Feldspar.] A species of compact feldspar, of an azure blue or green color, found amorphous associated with quartz and mica.

inlines.v: FEL'SITE, noun [See Feldspar.] A species of compact feldspar, of an azure blue or green color, found amorphous associated with quartz and mica.
